card.name: Linking words before named clinical studies
card.fires_on: Small linking words or modifiers inside a phrase that introduces a clinical trial or study, right before the study name or type word (study, trials). Seen after 'In' and inside long trial names.

modes.label: Inside trial names
modes.description: An 'and' or possessive inside a full study title, before the rest of the title.
modes.example: 5.10 Venothromboembolic Disease In the Fenofibrate Intervention<< and>> Event Lowering in Diabetes (FIELD)

modes.label: Study-type modifiers
modes.description: A hyphen piece or adjective in a phrase like short-term or longer-term studies, before the word trials or studies.
modes.example: In short<<-term>> schizophrenia trials, the proportion of patients with

modes.label: Article before a named study
modes.description: The word 'the' right before the name of a specific trial.
modes.example: 9 patients in<< the>> PURSUIT study, and no patients
